artifacts.title: Masthead (dark grey banner)
artifacts.summary: Full-width dark grey banner (cool grey #333333): white identity with a warm-grey descriptor, navigation as rounded pills (active item = orange pill).

a11y: Navigation is a <nav> list; the active item is a link state, not colour alone (pill shape carries it).

artifacts.title: Action (pill control)
artifacts.summary: Pill-shaped action: primary = solid orange; secondary = ghost with warm-grey outline; destructive = solid deep aubergine. Rounded language, generous padding.

a11y: Real <button> semantics; visible label is the accessible name; focus ring required.

source.path: orange = actions/community; deep aubergine for heaviest surfaces

artifacts.title: Field (text input)
artifacts.summary: Rounded text field: 1.5px warm border, radius 12, orange focus ring; label above in Medium; error note below in deep orange.

a11y: <label for> association always; error text linked via aria-describedby; never remove the visible label.

artifacts.title: Choice (small-set select)
artifacts.summary: Rounded select styled like a field, for small fixed sets (about 12 options or fewer); larger or filtered selection is out of scope by design.

a11y: Native semantics; visible label; never replace with a custom listbox for small sets.

source.path: authored limit rule; field language inferred

artifacts.title: Status (word-first pill)
artifacts.summary: Status as a pill containing the word: Available = warm tint with warm outline; On loan = solid aubergine; Overdue = solid orange. The word carries the status; colour supports it.

a11y: Status text is always present; never encode state by colour alone.

source.path: word-first rule; palette roles for tones

artifacts.title: Label (soft pill for metadata)
artifacts.summary: Category and metadata as a soft pill: warm-tint background, muted text, fully rounded. No border, no heavy fill — a gentle label, not a chip.

a11y: Plain text content; no meaning carried by colour.

artifacts.title: Surface (soft card)
artifacts.summary: Rounded white card with a soft warm shadow and generous padding; tinted variant uses the warm tint with no shadow. Used to group content gently — no hard borders.

a11y: Headings inside surfaces stay real headings.

source.path: tints for backgrounds; soft shadow authored

artifacts.title: Ledger (soft register list)
artifacts.summary: Data list with a pill-filled header row, airy rows separated by a very subtle alternating warm tint (no hard rules), hover row tint, status pills and labels inline, right-aligned text links.

states: empty (use a notice inside the view)
a11y: Real table semantics; generous row height; row action labels are specific verbs.

source.path: soft separation authored; no-hard-rules per warm language

artifacts.title: Meter (rounded progress)
artifacts.summary: Rounded progress bar: pill track in the warm tint with a solid fill (orange when in flight, aubergine when complete), always with a text readout like '7 of 10 steps'.

a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max; visible readout matches aria-valuetext; updates are static — no motion is defined in this system.

source.path: roundness inferred; motion undefined by design

artifacts.title: Notice (soft banner)
artifacts.summary: Rounded inline message: info = warm tint; warning = light orange tint; one or two plain sentences. No floating toasts, no left-edge stripes.

a11y: Role per kind (status vs alert); copy states what happened and what happens next.

source.path: orange tints for backgrounds (brand rule); warmth authored

artifacts.title: Dialog (rounded confirm)
artifacts.summary: Rounded white modal over a full-page warm scrim (deep aubergine at 35%): title in aubergine, a consequence sentence, pill actions (destructive = deep aubergine; cancel = outline).

a11y: Focus trapped; Escape closes; the confirm sentence names the object and the consequence.

source.path: scrim colour is a deep-aubergine tint; structure authored

artifacts.title: Section (grouping)
artifacts.summary: Content grouping: Medium aubergine heading, then generous spacing or a surface. No fieldset boxes; breathing room is the separator.

a11y: fieldset/legend semantics where the group is a form.

artifacts.title: Application shell
artifacts.summary: Dark grey masthead banner on top, white content column (max-width 1040, generous margins), a small footline at the column bottom.

a11y: One <main> landmark; the masthead is <header>.

artifacts.title: Register view (list screen)
artifacts.summary: Shell plus page head (title, subline, primary action) plus optional notice, a search field, and the ledger; empty state is a notice inside the view with one action.

a11y: Empty state announced; its copy offers exactly one next step.

artifacts.title: Form flow (create or edit)
artifacts.summary: Shell, a surface holding rounded fields and choices with labels above, then an actions row: primary pill and a secondary cancel; destructive actions route through the confirm dialog.

a11y: Validation summary is announced; the destructive confirm is keyboard reachable.

artifacts.title: Activity view (status and log)
artifacts.summary: Shell, a surface with a status pill and rounded meter with 'n of m' readout, an action to (re)start the job, and the event log as soft rows with muted timestamps.

a11y: State changes announced politely; meter readout text matches aria-valuetext.

artifacts.title: Indaba palette
artifacts.summary: Ubuntu palette with UI roles: orange #E95420 (actions), aubergine #77216F (identity/headings), deep aubergine #2C001E (destructive/heaviest), warm grey #AEA79F (balance), warm tint #F6F4F2 (surfaces), cool grey #333333 (banner), text #111111 (never pure black).

a11y: White text on orange and deep aubergine meets 4.5:1 (to be verified by indaba-lint); text uses #111111 rather than black.

artifacts.title: Indaba type roles
artifacts.summary: Ubuntu font family: display 28-30 Light in aubergine; headings 17-20 Medium in aubergine; body 16 Regular in #111111; labels 14 Medium; meta 13 muted; line-height 1.5.

a11y: Body at 16px or more; generous line-height; Ubuntu font is freely licensed (Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0).

source.path: font page; sizes authored for screen

artifacts.title: Rounded, warm, grey-balanced
artifacts.summary: The house language: everything is softly rounded (surfaces 12-16, controls and status as pills); separation comes from spacing, soft tints, and gentle shadows — not hard rules or heavy borders; colours are warm and balanced, never harsh.

a11y: Focus states use the orange ring; never remove the visible rounded affordance cues.

source.path: logo circles, typeface terminals, dot patterns; approved tile

artifacts.title: Voice: warm and plain
artifacts.summary: Copy is warm, plain and human — 'humanity towards others'. Short sentences; name the object and the consequence; no jargon, no filler.

a11y: Error and confirm copy states what happened and what happens next in one or two sentences.

artifacts.title: Source: Ubuntu brand guidelines (Canonical)
artifacts.summary: Public brand guidelines at design.ubuntu.com from which this system was derived; palette, font and values verified 2026-10-07. Provenance: docs/portability/09-ubuntu-source-audit.md. No Ubuntu marks are reproduced.
